summary: Inventory application is persistently available on node1 at TCP port 8181 while SELinux remains enforcing. It recovered successfully after the mandatory node restart.
actions_performed: Created the inventory application and persistent systemd service.
Enabled TCP 8181 in runtime and permanent firewalld configuration.
Kept SELinux configured and operating in enforcing mode.
Restarted node1 safely and verified application, data, firewall, and SELinux recovery.

evidence.requirement: Serve the inventory application over TCP 8181 with mandatory access control enforcing
evidence.summary: Before and after restart: SELinux enforcement is 1, the service is active/enabled, port 8181 is listening and allowed by firewalld, and the inventory page responds through the node IP.

Healthy baseline boot ID f0f8b8e0-5ebe-465b-8853-020a1ffc5b08 was captured, reboot was acknowledged, the new boot ID d93ec7fc-dac2-418b-bfaf-aa00113faff4 proves restart, and full application/MAC recovery was verified.
